event.title: Sydney Marathon Features Medal with Incorrect Stadium Design
event.canonical_title: Sydney Marathon Features Medal with Incorrect Stadium Design
event.summary: The Sydney Marathon organizers have acknowledged an error in the medals for the upcoming event, which will feature an engraving of the Allianz Arena, a stadium located in Germany, instead of Sydney landmarks. Despite the mix-up, organizers have stated that this mistake adds a unique touch to the medals. The marathon is set to take place with around 40,000 participants.

timeline.title: Sydney Marathon Features Medal with Incorrect Stadium Design
timeline.summary: The 2026 Sydney Marathon has drawn attention for unveiling a finishers' medal that features a stadium in Munich, Germany, instead of a local venue. Organisers have described the error as adding an 'international flavour' to the event.
key_facts: 2026 Sydney Marathon unveiled a medal with a design error.
The medal depicts a stadium in Munich, Germany.
Organisers claim the mistake adds 'international flavour'.
